groups.root_cause: The tail-cut overlap is too small to cover the longest supported JSON-escaped credential variants, so a cut-through credential partly survives redaction.
Excerpt line framing drops content such as blank lines, so multiline credentials no longer match before the excerpt is stored.
Retained failure-excerpt lines have no byte limit, so very long diagnostic lines are kept without bound.
Separately registered credential fragments are redacted before the full multiline credential, which stops the full credential from matching.
The privacy filter treats any text containing the literal "[redacted]" as private and withholds the whole thing, even when it holds no secret.
redactGateData is applied to whole API, prompt, report and state payloads, not just gate output, so it changes and saves over data that is not gate output.
The artifact endpoint parses JSON artifacts and serializes them again in compact form instead of serving the stored file bytes as they are.
